title: bomify deployment package description
description: The package description bomify passes a deployment plugin's "deployment generate" as --package, per plugins/contracts/deployment/v1/CONTRACT.md: the package, verified, and where each of its components is in the registry it's deployed from. A plugin ignores fields it doesn't know, so bomify can add some.

reference.description: The package, as given to "bomify deploy generate".

repository.description: The package's repository, where every component is.

digest.description: The package index's digest: what was verified.

components.description: Every component, in the SBOM's order.

artifactType.description: Its manifest's artifact type, if it has one. Absent for an image.

reference.description: "<repository>@<digest>": the component, pinned, in the package's repository, where it always is.

tagged.description: Where it's tagged, only if it is: bomify checked the tag exists and points at it.
